name: CsvToScriptableObjectImporter
src_typeComment: Window > Toolkit > CSV to ScriptableObject Importer: point at a CSV with a header row matching field names on a GameDataAsset subclass, and this creates/updates one asset per data row — turn a spreadsheet of 50 item stats into 50 balanced data assets in one click instead of hand-editing each one.

src_members.sig: public static void ShowWindow() => GetWindow<CsvToScriptableObjectImporter>("CSV to ScriptableObject Importer")
src_members.name: ShowWindow

src_members.sig: public static (int created, int updated) Import(Type dataType, string csvPath, string outputFolder, string idColumnName)
src_members.name: static
RunSelfTest
src_members.comment: Not exposed as a [MenuItem] on purpose (same reasoning as the animator generator's self-test) — creates a real synthetic CSV, imports it against the existing DemoItemData type, and checks the resulting assets have the expected field values.
